title: Morning Brief - Prem
intro_md: Type "more on G3" (or any code) here, or tap **More info** on an item on the brief page and paste the request here, and I'll dig in.

items.headline_md: **Trump** says he's inclined to **resume strikes on Iran after the New Year** if talks fail
items.summary_md: He called Iran's negotiators "professional tap dancers" and warned vessels trying to breach the US blockade would be sunk, per Fox News.

items.headline_md: **Zelenskyy** says Ukraine sank the Russian warship **Merkury** in **Benghazi**, Libya
items.summary_md: Kyiv also claimed a drone attack on the cargo ship MV Angara; Libya's eastern government filed a UN complaint.

items.headline_md: **NATO** meets after **Russian missiles hit Poland**
items.summary_md: Allies are set to discuss Friday's incursion, when Russian missiles and a drone came down in Poland.

items.headline_md: **COP31** in Antalya closes **without a deal**
items.summary_md: Summit president Murat Kurum blamed some countries for a lack of flexibility; UN chief Guterres said he was "deeply disappointed."

items.headline_md: Update: the Indonesia candy-factory fire death toll rises to **at least 24**, with dozens missing
items.summary_md: Rescuers are still searching the wreckage of the factory in Banten, west of Jakarta.

items.headline_md: Democrats reach **258 House seats**, their biggest majority since **1992**
items.summary_md: A recount win over Rep. Virginia Foxx in NC-5 brought their midterm gains to 44 seats, per AP results.

items.headline_md: **CrowdStrike** to buy **Zscaler** for **$43.9B**
items.summary_md: CEO George Kurtz says the deal aims to make it the world's largest "AI security" company.

items.headline_md: **South Korea, Taiwan and China** move to prop up stocks after the AI sell-off
items.summary_md: Taiwan's stabilization fund entered the market, Korea readied its fund, and China lowered margin requirements.

items.headline_md: UK outsourcer **Capita** shares **halve** as its CEO departs
items.summary_md: It cut 2027 profit guidance by £85m–£95m over civil-service pension contract costs and plans a ~£190m equity raise.

items.headline_md: The **EU** opens an antitrust probe into Coca-Cola bottler **CCEP**
items.summary_md: Brussels will examine whether it blocked cheaper cross-border trade in soft drinks.

sections.title: Games & mobile
sections.body_md: No new hyper-casual mobile news turned up in the last 24 hours.

items.headline_md: **The Binding of Isaac: Repentance+** pulls **AI-generated music** from its GTA-themed run
items.summary_md: A player found Suno references in the audio; Nicalis patched PC Saturday, consoles pending.

items.headline_md: **GTA VI** holds a **99 Metascore**, but its user score drops to about **5.5/10**
items.summary_md: Close to 45% of user ratings are negative, which looks like review-bombing, per Eurogamer and Numerama.

items.headline_md: **Darkest Dungeon II** reveals **The Butcher's Asylum**, a paid arena expansion due in **2027**
items.summary_md: Red Hook released a gameplay trailer Saturday; there's no exact date yet.

items.headline_md: Black Friday: Housemarque's **Saros** is **$40** on PS5 disc (down from $70)
items.summary_md: It's one of 2026's best-reviewed games, at 87 on Metacritic.

sections.title: Video Game Emulation
sections.body_md: No PS5 or Switch 2 emulation breakthrough with commercial games in the last 24–48 hours. Wii U lifter watch: [CafeRecomp](https://github.com/hardkiller2565123123/CafeRecomp) is still public, but its [Releases page](https://github.com/hardkiller2565123123/CafeRecomp/releases) still has no release. GTA VI: still no verified native-PC recomp or port. Nov 22 builds include PCSX2 v2.9.189, RPCS3, Xenia/Xenia Edge, Vita3K, Dolphin 2609-308 and FCEUX 2.8.0 ([EmuCR](https://www.emucr.com/2026_11_22_archive.html)). Reddit (r/emulation, r/decomps) couldn't be read this run (404 on RSS, timeout on old.reddit).

items.headline_md: PS3 shooter **MAG** runs natively on Windows, macOS and Linux via **static recompilation**
items.summary_md: Developer tekulvw built it with the ps3recomp SDK, and it supports community servers.

items.headline_md: **BioShock 2** Xbox 360 recomp hits **v0.2.1**, adding offline bots and 60 FPS logic
items.summary_md: It brings the Xbox 360 game to Windows as a static recompilation.

items.headline_md: **Torchlight Recomp v1.0.0** brings the Xbox 360 ARPG to PC, Mac and Android
items.summary_md: Built on the ReXGlue SDK, it translates the PowerPC executable to native C++; you supply your own XBLA files.

items.headline_md: PS2: **Maximo Rex** starts static-recompilation work on **Maximo vs. Army of Zin**
items.summary_md: It's an early, source-only PS2Native project for the PAL version on Windows.

items.headline_md: N64 **BattleTanx** gets a native Windows/Linux port via static recompilation (**btrecomp 0.1.5**)
items.summary_md: Developer wootbeer released it, one of several new recomp ports today.

items.headline_md: **openMSX 22.0** adds raster-beam debugging tools and more hardware support
items.summary_md: It also brings VDP accuracy fixes and support for light guns, plotters and SM-X WiFi.

items.headline_md: Update: **Sunrise on the Reaping** opens to **$225M worldwide**, Lionsgate's biggest global start in some time
items.summary_md: It beat Wicked: For Good's $223M and topped 81 of its 84 markets, led by the UK at $17.4M.

items.headline_md: A24's **You Can See Everything** passes **$100M worldwide**, rare for a documentary
items.summary_md: The Theranos doc made for about $7M is at $102.4M globally and opened to $3.2M in the UK.

items.headline_md: **Robert Eggers** says he's "eager" for a break from horror after **Werwulf**
items.summary_md: Werwulf, with Aaron Taylor-Johnson, Lily-Rose Depp and Willem Dafoe, opens on Christmas Day.

items.headline_md: **OpenAI**'s chief scientist proposes industry-wide **limits on AI development** tied to a "perplexity" metric
items.summary_md: Jakub Pachocki says labs shouldn't cross agreed thresholds until monitoring catches up; Sam Altman backed it.

items.headline_md: **Sarvam** releases **Sarvam-105B-1711**, an open-weight model at **$0.15 per million tokens**
items.summary_md: It's built for support, voice and agent work, and the company says it matches Gemini 3.5 Flash-Lite at far lower cost.

items.headline_md: **Apple** starts rolling out **Siri AI** across its own apps
items.summary_md: Calendar, Mail, Maps, Messages, Photos and more get it; third-party App Intents stay in developer preview, not allowed in App Store builds.

items.headline_md: **Signal** will block **Siri** and **Gemini** from reading your chats on iOS 27 and Android
items.summary_md: President Meredith Whittaker calls AI agents embedded in the OS "an existential threat to Signal."

items.headline_md: **Delta** fixes the weight-and-balance system glitch that delayed flights across the US
items.summary_md: The fix comes ahead of Thanksgiving travel.
It's a relief bounce after seven straight down days left the S&P and Dow in correction; the VIX is still at its highest since April 2025.

items.headline_md: Premarket at 4:21 AM CT: **Nvidia +8.6%**, **Anthropic +4.47%**
items.summary_md: Neoclouds also rebounded (Nebius +10.9%, CoreWeave +9.7%); the Nasdaq fell 10% last week.
Attacks on Gulf shipping are limiting the losses.

items.headline_md: Gold at 2:25 AM CT: **$3,604.79/oz (+2.1%)**, rebounding from a 14-month low
items.summary_md: It fell 9% last week; markets still price a 25-basis-point Fed hike in December.

items.headline_md: Crypto at 5:09 AM CT: **Bitcoin $61,353 (+0.8%)**, **Ether $1,723.14 (+0.8%)** over 24 hours
items.summary_md: These are spot prices from CoinGecko.

sections.title: Weather
sections.body_md:
No ice storm or tornado threat for the St. Louis area in the next 7 days (NWS/SPC). No active NWS alerts at either point ([NWS alerts](https://api.weather.gov/alerts/active?point=38.7875,-90.6299)). Heads-up for Thanksgiving: NWS St. Louis puts precipitation chances at 50–70% Wednesday night into Thanksgiving morning, mainly east of I-55, mostly rain with a possible brief rain/snow mix near sunrise, but says "the potential for impacts from snow remains very low." Tuesday is the coolest day, with highs near 40 north to mid-40s south ([NWS St. Louis discussion](https://forecast.weather.gov/product.php?site=LSX&issuedby=LSX&product=AFD), issued 2:26 AM CT). SPC: severe storms unlikely today ([Day 1](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day1otlk.html)), not expected Tuesday ([Day 2](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day2otlk.html)), Wednesday's risk is in South Florida ([Day 3](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/outlook/day3otlk.html)), and "severe potential appears limited" Thu–Mon ([Day 4–8](https://www.spc.noaa.gov/products/exper/day4-8/)). I didn't check the WPC winter outlooks, and no LSX Hazardous Weather Outlook was issued recently.

items.headline_md: **From mocked to mainstream: how Spain's far-right Vox transformed its fortunes**
items.summary_md: It's a clear look at how a party that won 0.2% in 2016 is now polling near 20% and could join Spain's next government.
